requirements.text: Students must be able to personalise their timetables by colour-coding modules.
Students must have the option to hide cancelled classes from their timetables.
Students must be able to add their own study blocks to their timetables.
Students must have the option to export or sync their personalised timetable with external calendar applications like Google Calendar or Outlook.
The system must send instant notifications to students when new grades are posted.
The system must send automated reminders to students about upcoming assignment deadlines and exam dates.
Students must be able to configure their notification preferences regarding the method of delivery (email, SMS, in-app messages) and frequency.
The feedback submission process must be straightforward and structured to guide students in providing meaningful feedback.
Feedback submissions must be anonymous to encourage honest responses from students.
Feedback must be accessible to module coordinators only after the grade submission deadline to maintain integrity.
Module coordinators must be able to view aggregated, anonymised feedback results.
Academic administrators must have the ability to generate reports on module feedback trends across departments and semesters.
The enhancements must integrate seamlessly with the current portal without creating additional hurdles for students.
The system must adhere to data protection regulations such as GDPR.
